title.label: Absolutely amazing app especially if you have ADD

content.label:
amazing how much progress has been made on it since I first downloaded it. One feature request would be to put a lock on the app itself so you can’t edit anything, be if time based (can only change settings at like 9-10am or one day a week) pin based or even in charity donation based 😂 Already on the one day premium, would love to upgrade to the lifetime purchase tho! 

 one odd bug tho is that it now seems to show evey apps you support on the homepage since activated the blocking schedule one one app

title.label: One Major Issue but overall great app

content.label: The app is good, but the setup is a bit clunky and hard to follow
One sec is an amazing app and works really well. Would highly recommend it to anyone who wants better screen time.

So I downloaded this, followed the instructions and it worked. Brilliant. Then cut to an hour later and I realised I was staring at Instagram. What happen to the app? It had simply stopped working. Checked the app, said it was still down loaded and applied to Instagram but when I opened Instagram it no longer worked. Went onto Shortcuts and checked - all still set up correctly, but still not kicking in. Waste of time, so glad I decided to road test before purchasing. Deleted.
After installing this app I’ve cut my social media usage by over 90% and also stopped constantly checking emails unnecessarily. Healthier and happier as a result. Thanks for making this!

This app is amazing. I spend far too long on YouTube and setting limits through apple didn’t stop it. This app has reduced my consumption so much and I can’t recommend it enough! If you can, upgrade to premium for £10 a year - the focus with no mercy is brilliant.

Note: found a bug regarding setting new healthy habits when picking an emoji. Scrolling left to right causes the emoji bar to drop down. Also ‘visually’ is spelt wrong in the Intention Tracking settings.

This app has definitely reduced my screen time significantly and is well worth the subscription cost. It would be great if the number of rotations required to unlock an app could be altered, ideally I want it to start at one rotation and increase each time I use the app.
breaks the cycle of going on social media without even noticing i'm doing it, has saved me so much time and gave me control back over how much time i spend on my phone.
This has literally saved my grades, it is basically instinct to click on twitter and scroll for me. My predicted grade was a 4, I got an 8!

I like it’s concept, and it would be a great thing to help with phone addiction, however, it is a bit broken. I have 3 apps connected to this, and the app gets the name of the app wrong every time, so when I press continue, it takes me to the wrong app
But. The count should be how many times you’ve actually opened it rather than how many times you try to. Sometimes ends up I just don’t close the app because I’m trying to keep my number down

title.label: Useful but expensive subscription and hampered by bugs

content.label:
Very helpful app to steer people away from pointless time wasting and doom scrolling – it has helped me cut time wasted on Facebook by over 90%. 

However, the content blocker plugin to stop you using Safari to get around the block is bugged and interrupts access to random unrelated websites – I had to turn that off. 

I would pay a reasonable amount (e.g. 5-10 pounds) for this app but charging a subscription is not reasonable for something that doesn’t deliver continuous new content, and 35 is just too much.
No faults at all does everything you need it to. It is all at such a generous price without selling you off to data companies. I will always support apps and initiatives like these. Thank you

title.label: Great app, doesn’t currently work with iOS 16

content.label:
The app itself is brilliant - a simple solution which has massively reduced my screen time, and made me more productive at work.

We all have a tendency to unconsciously open apps we regularly use (often social media); Downloading this app makes you realise how often you actually do this. For most people, I think they’d be surprised!

I’ve used this app for a while and I recommend it to anyone who struggles with overusing their phone. 

My only gripe: *It doesn't seem to work with iOS 16*. I realise this iOS only a Beta and I’m sure the Dev for this app is hard at work, but I want this app back in my life!

I guess shortcuts updated recently. But i was really confused on how to set the app up. Shortcuts is complicated and I'm downloading this app BECAUSE tiktok ruined my attention span and so i gave uo after about 5 mins

I don’t normally leave reviews but this app is so simple yet it’s awesome! I’m not very tech minded so when I watched the video how to set it up I thought help! But I did it and it was straight forward. If I can do it then so can do 🤣.  I’ve only had it days but already told friends and family about it. I spend wayyy too much time on social media (and Amazon🤣) so this will be a godsend. Thanks guys and I’ve subscribed 👍  10/10.

title.label: Exactly what I was looking for

content.label:
Such an awesome app, whenever my mind wanders it always heads to Instagram Reels and I end up wasting a decent amount of time before I snap out of it.

One suggestion: Can you make an option for the App Closing Reminders to recur? :) I think it'd be awesome if for example every 3 minutes it has a notifier saying "Are you still following intentions" etc. As sometimes there are valid reasons to use an app and you might not get it all done in your reminders time window.

Thank you for making this app!

The concept is simple yet effective. It prevents mindless use of apps of your choice. I chose to try this out with Facebook. It makes opening the app a bit of a nuisance, things like rotating your phone three times, following a circle on screen with your finger or waiting six seconds while you breathe in and out. Usually even the thought of having to do the exercise just to scroll through an app you don’t actually have any good intention of using prevents you from opening the app. My usage of Facebook has dropped 74% in a week. I would highly recommend this app.

I’m getting more work done and focusing on my studies and workday much better. The impact it’s having is invaluable.

title.label: Great idea, but a bit buggy right now

content.label: Fantastic idea. Really helped me identify my usage on social media. However, it seems a bit buggy right now. If you turn it off for some apps, it seems to turn it off for random other ones. Some apps aren’t listed, so you can’t use this app for everything. It would be good to be able to group apps together, for instance: if you were to open one social media app, then all others will be unlocked for the next 5 minutes. I’ll be back once this app is a bit more developed and more useable.
I tried so many methods, but this is literally the only one that stopped me mindlessly jumping between apps!!

title.label: love the app but add more options

content.label:
Great app! The breathing exercises and are all up in your businesses unlike with other apps which just sit passively in the background. This makes it hard to ignore and more effective! 
I have a bad habit of going to the Photos app to check for updates in some shared albums im part of. I wanted to include 'Photos' in the OneSec shortcut but it didn't let me :( Same with 'PvZ 2'.
A lot of nonsense to try to get money off you during set up phase, not clear how to skip ‘pro’ version and to just do what it says on the tin. Deleted app within couple of minutes of downloading.
Advertised as free on Twitter but you need to pay
It may seem like a simple solution but I can tell you it 100% works. Everyone needs this.
Love the app. One thing that would push it up to 5 stars for me would be being able to disable it on weekends/specific days!

The app itself seems fairly nicely focussed and does just what it says on the tin! A little delay before you open an app… the integration isn’t perfect, there are little pop ups from ‘shortcuts’ and you have to create the automations manually, but it seems worth it at this point…
Then the shocker comes, to use it with more than one app you need to subscribe. Yep, that’s an ongoing payment just to play an animation before your app opens.
It’s a shame, I would’ve happily paid a one off fee, but this feels like blatant profiteering.

I love the fact that the app helped me stop mindlessly going on Instagram. However once I get on the app and think to go on for five minutes, I end up scrolling for hours. A suggestion would be to have a timer showing how long you’ve been on the app and perhaps a reminder saying your predetermined time is up.
Brilliant

title.label: Because screen time limits simply don’t work

content.label: Such a great idea - helping me get off Instagram one breath at a time.
